issue_request: FHIR-37494 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested text explaining that the Known Identifier Systems table Type column corresponds to Identifier.type, using a code from the Identifier Type code system when Identifier.type is present.
initial_application: Core source commits 423ca82214db3fb202981dea37a93eda930d8274 and 2164932efc3e1210494f88c1ee70c46423093434 added the requested Type sentence to source/identifier-registry.html and then fixed the Identifier.type link.
additional_context: FHIR-35932 later removed the core identifier systems table after migration to HL7 Terminology/THO. The current build-scoped source/identifier-registry.html now points implementers to HL7 Terminology for actively curated identifier systems. The THO NPI NamingSystem preserves the Jira example's mapping with type coding http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0203#PRN.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is needed because there is no current core Type column to define and reintroducing table-specific prose would be stale.
